#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>

using namespace std;

const int MOD = 1000000007;
const long long INV2 = (MOD + 1) / 2;

int calculate(int n) {
    int size = 2 * n + 1;
    if (size < 0) {
        throw "NegativeArraySizeException";
    }

    vector<int> cPrev(size, 0);
    vector<int> dPrev(size, 0);
    cPrev[0] = 1;
    dPrev[0] = 1;

    for (int depth = 1; depth <= 2 * n; depth++) {
        vector<int> cCur(size, 0);
        vector<int> dCur(size, 0);

        for (int opened = depth & 1; opened <= depth; opened += 2) {
            int sumC = 0;
            int sumD = 0;

            if (opened > 0) {
                sumC += cPrev[opened - 1];
                sumD += dPrev[opened - 1];
            }
            if (opened + 1 < size) {
                sumC += cPrev[opened + 1];
                sumD += dPrev[opened + 1];
            }

            cCur[opened] = (sumC + 1) % MOD;
            int dVal = (1 - sumD) % MOD;
            if (dVal < 0) {
                dVal += MOD;
            }
            dCur[opened] = dVal;
        }

        cPrev.swap(cCur);
        dPrev.swap(dCur);
    }

    long long diff = cPrev[0] - dPrev[0];
    diff %= MOD;
    if (diff < 0) {
        diff += MOD;
    }
    return (int)((diff * INV2) % MOD);
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    
    int n;
    cin >> n;
    
    cout << calculate(n) << endl;
    
    return 0;
}
